# .github/workflows/

**Intentionally empty.**

This is where the GitHub Actions workflow files will go. Nothing has been
written for you — we build these together so you understand every line.

What will likely end up here:

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `deploy.yml` | Publish the site to GitHub Pages on push to `main` |
| `playwright.yml` | Run the Playwright suite and publish the HTML report |

Note: if you enable GitHub Pages using the **"Deploy from a branch"** setting,
you do not need `deploy.yml` at all — GitHub serves the repo directly. We will
pick the approach that teaches you the most useful thing.
